verdict.rationale: React clearly supports modular, encapsulated components that compose into complex UIs (react-gh-1, react-gh-3, react-docs-8), but the evidence pack contains no mention of a dependency-injection mechanism (e.g., Context API, custom hooks for DI) to back the 'dependency-injected' half of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Context/DI patterns, examples of injecting dependencies into components, independent corroboration of DI usage in real apps.
